name: Charles Water Sports
summary: A beach watersports business on Dover Beach run by Charles Pilgrim, who has over thirty-five years in sea sports and says he was the first Barbadian to introduce windsurfing to the island. It hires out sailing dinghies, small catamarans, windsurfers, surfboards, paddle boards, kayaks, snorkel gear and jet skis, with instructors for sailing and windsurfing, and sells a turtle swimming trip. Book by phone or at the beach.
standouts: Charles Pilgrim has over thirty-five years of experience in sea sports
Says he was the first Barbadian to introduce windsurfing to the island
Sailing and windsurfing with an instructor
Two live webcams of Dover Beach linked from the site
